name: Thang co
summary: Thắng cố is the northwest offal stew the ethnic desk describes two ways: horse in the lede, and horse or buffalo, meat and offal, in the body. Sa Pa serves it with rượu ngô. It was on the Cát Cát stalls at Gầu Tào on 28 February 2026.
origin: The ethnic-tourism page is about the northwest, not one Sa Pa stall. Its lede says Mong thắng cố is made from horse meat. Its body says thắng cố of the Mong, Tay, and Thai is usually horse meat and horse offal, or buffalo meat and buffalo offal.
culture: The same page ties northwest feast food to guests, festivals, and visitors in a village. At Cát Cát, thắng cố was among the foods at Gầu Tào on 28 February 2026.
taste: The page says a first taste can be hard because of a ngai ngái smell. That is the page’s note.
howToEat: Eat it with rượu ngô, which is how the ethnic desk says it is drunk.
A weekday stall in town was not named. At Cát Cát, look for it when Gầu Tào is on. Otherwise Check on arrival.
where: Cát Cát, xã Tả Van, on 28 February 2026, at the Gầu Tào stalls. A town door for an ordinary day is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Thang co in Sapa — horse or buffalo, with corn wine
seoDescription: Northwest thắng cố, printed as horse and as horse or buffalo, eaten with rượu ngô. It was at Cát Cát for Gầu Tào on 28 February 2026.
